mapper.select: SELECT USERID ,USERPASS ,SHOPNO ,GRADE ,USERNAME ,CHK ,GKEY ,GUBUN FROM USER_SHOP A WHERE 1=1 AND USERID != '' AND A.USERID = #{SID} AND A.USERPASS = #{SPASS}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SEND_MST ( KIND, KINDSHOP, SENDKEY, SYYMM, SDATE, STIME, REMK, TOTCNT, SUCCESS, FAIL, SENDKINDSHOP, INTOT, INCNT, INSERVICE, FINISH) SELECT '01' ,'01' + #{CUSTCD} ,#{JPNO} ,LEFT(#{KJSKDATE},6) ,#{KJSKDATE} ,DATEFORMAT(GETDATE(),'HHNN') ,'WEB' ,0 ,0 ,0 ,#{PRUSER} ,#{CASHAMT} ,#{CASHAMT} ,0 ,0 FROM DUMMY
mapper.update: UPDATE SHOP_TB SET CNT = CNT + #{CASHAMT} WHERE KINDSHOP = '01' + #{CUSTCD}
UPDATE SHOP_LIST SET KJMARK='Y',KJDATE=#{KJDATE} WHERE SHOPNO = #{CUSTCD}
mapper.select: SELECT L.KJDATE KJDATE, L.SHOPNO SHOPNO, L.SHOPNAME SHOPNAME, L.IPNO IPNO, T.CNT CNT FROM SHOP_LIST L ,SHOP_TB T WHERE T.KINDSHOP = '01' + L.SHOPNO AND (L.SHOPNAME LIKE #{FIND} + '%' OR L.GROUPNO LIKE #{FIND} + '%' )
SELECT L.SHOPNO SHOPNO, L.SHOPNAME SHOPNAME, L.IPNO IPNO FROM SHOP_LIST L WHERE GROUPNO = #{GROUPNO}
